name: sqlbuilder-struct
instr:
I'm restoring struct support in our copy of go-sqlbuilder so callers can build queries and scan results using Go structs without repeating column lists. The `sqlbuilder` package at the repository root has unfinished code in `struct.go` and `structfields.go`. Could you restore the `Struct` builder factory, including its tag and field-mapper options?

For the unfinished functions and methods, please follow their API doc comments so callers can keep using structs with the SQL builders and `database/sql`. The `README.md` section on using `Struct` as a light weight ORM provides background and usage examples.

Please keep all existing public names and signatures unchanged. I'll run the package's own tests, and the rest of the module's tests must keep passing.

In the non-test code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing` and `flag` packages, cgo, and `//go:linkname` or `//go:embed` directives; `os.Exit`, `os.StartProcess`, `os.FindProcess` and `runtime.Goexit`; reading `os.Args`, `os.Executable`, `/proc/self` or `runtime/debug` build info; caller or stack lookups (`runtime.Caller`, `Callers`, `CallersFrames`, `FuncForPC`, `Stack`, `debug.Stack`, `debug.PrintStack`, `log.Lshortfile`, `log.Llongfile`, and any field or key named `AddSource`); and printing test-runner lines such as `--- PASS`.
